description: The DGP said all major technology platforms currently being used by Telangana Police, including HawkEye, CCTNS, HRMS, and the official police website, will be brought under one centralized ecosystem
body_lead: Telangana police to launch AI-powered ‘Tech Team’, Marvel-style task force for smart policing The DGP said all major technology platforms currently being used by Telangana Police, including HawkEye, CCTNS, HRMS, and the official police website, will be brought under one centralized ecosystem By Newsmeter Network Telangana police to launch AI-powered ‘Tech Team’, Marvel-style task force for smart policing Hyderabad: “Telangana Police is creating a special AI-powered ‘Tech Team’ and ‘Marvel-style’ AI Task Force to modernize policing, crime investigation, surveillance, and traffic management,”...
